title: Penalties for Late or Incomplete Tax Payments and Reports

passages.question: What does ESD charge if the Q3 report is filed or the tax paid after November 2, 2026?
passages.excerpt: If your tax payment is late, we will charge you interest at a rate of 1% of total taxes due per month. We also charge a late payment penalty fee for overdue taxes: First month: 5% of total taxes due or $10, whichever is more. ... We charge a $25 penalty for each late report. ... In some cases, you can ask us to waive penalties for filing a late report or tax payment.
